svg.title: The repayment boundary
svg.desc: Coverage sensitivity to price and billed hours, initial values indexed to 100.
svg.text: Each cell shows cash available divided by the annual debt payment.
At 80% of billed hours, 91.16% of the original price is needed to meet the payment exactly.
Cash costs held at $18m. Annual payment: $18.47m. 1.35 is an illustrative buffer; colours do not imply probabilities.
